formal_tasks: P1 foundation for task1 operating factors/time features and task2 temperature-constrained response; no market integration or self-supervised branch.
first_question: In a verified room/air-conditioning zone, can a simple model improve short-horizon recorded indoor-temperature prediction over persistence under explicitly historical input availability?
entity_rule: Room sensors/control terminals and block-level metering are different entities. Toshiba VRF terminals share systems; no per-room electricity invented from block meter.
physics_reference: Room heat balance C*dT/dt=H*(Tout-T)+internal/solar heat-HVAC cooling, with separate heating mode. Generic model relationship, not already identified physical parameters.
candidate_simple_models: previous-slope extrapolation if historical cadence supports it
small linear autoregression with strictly preceding outdoor/state/setpoint values; fit training only
not_frozen_yet: Exact entity, time horizon, quality rules, split, predictors and success threshold await original field/time QA before any model/error computation.
not_claimed: causal effect from observational control status
completion_direction: Source/object and parameter evidence, actual data per use, frozen samples/reference, simple fair baseline comparison including failures, independent reproduction; only validated final components curated after closure.
preserve: Prior storage/PV/EV packages and teacher/handoff remain; no cross-resource integration, no new formal report, no GPU required for source QA and simple baselines.
